blocks.html: Easytrip Services Corporation, a Metro Pacific Tollways Company, officially inaugurated its first permanent and fully digital shop at Robinsons Galleria, marking another milestone in making road travel more seamless and convenient for motorists.

Since 2020, Easytrip Services Corporation has been in partnership with Robinsons Land to make RFID installation, card replacement, and reloading more accessible and convenient to its customers in various regions. Of all the Easytrip RFID stations in different Robinsons Malls, Robinsons Galleria emerged as the top choice among its online customers as the ideal site for the brand’s first permanent hub.

Designed to deliver hassle-free, paperless, and efficient experiences, the new Easytrip RFID Shop prioritizes online appointments through its fully digital system. Customers can now enjoy faster processing times with real-time data encoding and exclusive lanes for online bookings allowing them to get their RFID installed in five minutes or less with complete requirements.

Present during the inauguration ceremony were Metro Pacific Tollways Mobility Corporation (MPT Mobility) Vice President and OIC Angel Carbo, and Easytrip Services Corporation AVP and OIC for Operations Ycel Resurreccion. Representing Robinsons Land Corporation were Vice President for Operations and Marketing Joel S. Lumanlan and Transport Head Raymie Delos Reyes.

“This new Easytrip RFID office is a testament to how we continue to innovate for our customers. By going fully digital, we’re making the process faster and easier. Our partnership with Robinsons Malls has been instrumental since 2023 in bringing our services closer to motorists, a win-win for both our organizations,” said Angel Carbo, Vice President and OIC of MPT Mobility.

Strategically located at Basement 1 of Robinsons Galleria, near Reli Tours and the parking entrance, the Easytrip RFID Office is open daily from 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM. As the most accessible RFID station in Metro Manila, motorists can now get their Easytrip RFID without having to enter the expressway, a first in its kind for ultimate customer convenience.

“At Robinsons Malls, we’re always looking for innovative ways to better serve our customers. We are happy to be Easytrip’s partner for its first permanent digital shop, and we’re excited to welcome more customer-motorists at Robinsons Galleria”, said Joel Lumanlan, Robinsons Malls Vice President for Operations and Marketing.
For more information on services available at Robinsons Malls, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or follow Robinsons Malls on their official social media channels.
